_about: Outside calorie references per template serving, checked by check_template_calories.py after every matcher run. kcal is the reference normalised to OUR serving (null when none is usable). status: ok (compare), serving_differs, not_comparable (the reason is in note), none. See RECIPE_RULES.md, 'Calorie reference'. First filled by the 11-13 Nov 2026 audit.

philly_cheesesteak.note: Ours uses 1.5 lb ribeye for 4 (reference 1 lb, trimmed) plus 2 tbsp oil.

cobb_salad.note: Reference serves 6-8 (nutrition per 8); ours is a main-course quarter.

chicken_caesar_salad.basis: 396 per side serving of 5, no chicken or egg
chicken_caesar_salad.note: The reference leaves out the chicken.

jambalaya_.note: The reference uses 2 cups rice (ours 1 1/4), 1 3/4 lb skin-on thighs (ours 12 oz skinless), 13 oz andouille and 1 lb shrimp.

mashed_potatoes.note: Per 1/2 cup; our serving is a sixth of the batch, cups not stated.

cornbread_.note: The reference uses 3/4 cup oil and 1 cup sugar; ours 6 tbsp butter and 1/4 cup sugar.

baked_beans.note: Serves 16 from a larger batch; ours serves 8.

hash_browns.note: Same 2 tbsp oil and 2 tbsp butter for 4. The reference's 7 g fat is less than half that; ours counts all the pan fat.

macaroni_and_cheese.note: The reference uses 1 lb dry macaroni, 4 cups cheddar plus parmesan and cream; ours 5 cups cooked macaroni and 2 2/3 cups cheddar.

brownies_.basis: 526 per square of 12, so 395 for our 16 squares from one pan

pumpkin_pie.note: Same filling (15 oz pumpkin, 10 oz evaporated milk, 2 eggs, 3/4 cup sugar). The reference's 7 g fat is less than its own crust and evaporated milk carry, so its figure looks low.

cheesecake_.basis: 659 per slice of 10, so 549 for our 12 slices

banana_bread.basis: 350 per slice of 10 includes 1 cup walnuts (765) and 1/2 cup raisins (247); without them 249, so 207 for our 12 slices

sweet_tea.basis: None of the three source pages prints calories
